Timings are the **median of three warm requests** from wherever this ran, so they include network distance to the incumbent and none to us. They are a comparison, not an absolute. The cold-path figures that motivated the migration are in [benchmarks.md](benchmarks.md); a cold path can only be measured once per cache lifetime and so cannot be sampled here.
